entities.name: Mutapa Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Mutapa Empire, a political institution in Zimbabwe during Great Zimbabwe and Successor States (1430–1760). Grew from Great Zimbabwe City and Great Zimbabwe Peak. Led to the emergence of Mutapa Empire (Kingdom of Mutapa) and Rozvi Confederacy Founded.
